blocks.title: Activity diagram
blocks.text: Activity diagrams kisi amal mein sargarmiyon ya qadmon ka bahao dikhate hain. Yeh pecheeda kaamon ki mantiq (logic) ka model banane ke liye mufeed hain.

Misal: restaurant management system mein activity diagram order dene se khana tayyar karne aur aakhir mein order deliver karne tak ka amal dikha sakta hai (Fig. 1.12). Amal Start se shuru ho kar Order Placement, phir Food Preparation tak jata hai; ek faisle ka diamond poochta hai ke khana tayyar hai ya nahi: haan to Order Delivery, nahi to Re-prepare Food aur wapas; End node amal khatam karta hai. Teer tarteeb dikhate hain, jis se order ki taraqqi samajhna aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: Sequence diagram ka activity diagram se muwazna kijiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Sequence diagram lifelines ke saath dikhata hai ke kaunse objects ek doosre ko kaunse paigham kis waqt ki tarteeb mein bhejte hain; activity diagram ek amal ke qadam aur faisle start se end tak action dabbon, faisle ke diamonds aur teeron se dikhata hai, yeh dikhaye baghair ke har qadam kaunsa object karta hai.

items: Activity diagram: kisi amal mein qadmon aur faislon ka bahao (Fig. 1.12: start, order placement, food preparation, tayyar? faisla, delivery ya dobara tayyari, end).
